## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-09-07: Form-of Exchange TRA filed as Ex 10.6 to S-1/A (unexecuted)
- 2021-09-14: Up-C IPO closes; Exchange TRA executed with Continuing Members of Dutch Mafia, LLC
- 2021-09-17: Executed Exchange TRA filed as Ex 10.3 to closing 8-K

#### Liability growth from Exchanges

- 2025-02-13: FY2024 10-K discloses $341.2M of additions to combined TRA liability from 2024 Exchanges
- 2026-02-13: FY2025 10-K reports first $4.7M TRA cash payment and $202.7M of additions from 2025 Exchanges; combined TRA liability $821.0M; identified as KPMG critical audit matter

## Explanation

Dutch Bros Inc. executed two parallel Tax Receivable Agreements at the close of its September 14, 2021 Up-C IPO; this file covers the Exchange TRA with the Continuing Members of Dutch Mafia, LLC (the OpCo partnership). The contract pays 85% of realized tax benefits attributable to PubCo's allocable share of existing OpCo tax basis, anticipated Section 743(b)/734(b) basis adjustments from future Exchanges of OpCo Class A common units for PubCo Class A stock or cash, 704(c) Benefits from the pre-IPO reorganization, and tax benefits from payments under the TRA itself. The liability has grown materially as Continuing Members have exchanged units: from $290.9M at YE2023 to $821.0M (combined with the Reorganization TRA) at YE2025, with the first cash payment of $4.7M made in 2025. The TRA remains in force as of the FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-13). See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
